ADDRESS LIFETIME

Built for a short visit

Addresses usually last up to an hour. An inactive provider session can end sooner. Keep the tab handy until your message arrives.

PRIVACY AND LIMITS

Use a temporary address for temporary things

Guerrilla Mail receives and stores messages. MailGuest keeps the active address and session token in your browser tab. Removing an address clears that browser session. Provider retention still applies.

Use a permanent address for sensitive messages, important accounts, or anything you may need to recover later.

QUICK ANSWERS

Frequently asked questions

Can I send or reply to an email?

MailGuest is receive-only.

What if my email hasn’t arrived?

Check the address, make sure it’s still active, and use Refresh. Some senders block disposable addresses or take longer to deliver.

Does the address stay after I reload?

A reload in the same browser tab can restore the active address while the provider session is valid.

Can I recover a removed address?

MailGuest clears the local session when you remove the address. Generate a new address when you need another inbox.

Can I choose the address or domain?

Guerrilla Mail assigns the address and domain automatically.

Ready for your next message?

Your active address is at the top of the page.
